scientific_scope: Prospective source-family robustness in synthetic paired choice, no external generalization claims
hypothesis: A train-only minimax source-family margin-weighted batch update improves minimum per-family sealed accuracy over fixed equally source-balanced full-batch on fresh cohorts without material degradation of overall or family accuracy.

training_algorithm.control: R52 three-source equal 576-per-family full-batch fixed budget
training_algorithm.candidate: For each epoch, group equal 576-per-family signed examples. Compute per-family mean hinge loss on training examples only. Select the family with maximum mean hinge loss; on a tie, select the earliest enumerated family. Update 16 weights by learning_rate times signed-feature sum of currently misclassified examples from selected family divided by 576. Compute no heldout metrics or updates during training.

decision_rule.unit: per-development-block model evaluated across the same 48 sealed heldout seeds with identity and xor55 encoding equality
decision_rule.strict: candidate worst-family accuracy - equal-balanced control worst-family accuracy >= .05 AND candidate overall accuracy >= .55 AND each candidate family accuracy - control family accuracy >= -.05
outcomes: else PARTIAL_MINIMAX_GAIN if at least two blocks partial
decision_rule.invalidity: Freeze/source drift, budget/seed leak, raw metric inconsistency, invalid numerical values or mismatched result SHA mean INVALID; interrupted first-use means CONSUMED_INDETERMINATE and no retry
